planets.name: TOI-2141 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2141 with a 18.3-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2141 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-2141. Its orbit and size follow Luque et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
